segments.name: Wholesale Banking
segments.description: Provides lending, leasing, deposit, treasury management, capital market, equipment finance and wealth management services to CRE, commercial, industrial and wealth clients.
segments.evidence: Our Wholesale Banking segment provides loan, leasing, deposit services, treasury management, and capital market services to our wholesale customers throughout Virginia, Maryland, Washington, D.C., North Carolina, and South Carolina.

segments.name: Consumer Banking
segments.description: Provides loans, deposits, retail brokerage, home loans and investment management services to consumers and small businesses in the Mid-Atlantic.
segments.evidence: Our Consumer Banking segment provides loan and deposit services and retail brokerage services to consumers and small businesses throughout Virginia, Maryland, Washington, D.C. and North Carolina.

revenueModel.text: The bank earns interest on loans and investments funded by customer deposits, plus fee-based revenue from treasury management, capital markets, wealth management and brokerage services.
revenueModel.evidence: Treasury management services generate fee-based revenue, deepen client relationships, and support our core deposit franchise.

changes.text: In 2025, the company sold performing CRE loans acquired in the Sandy Spring acquisition.
changes.evidence: On June 26, 2025, we completed the sale of performing CRE loans acquired in the Sandy Spring acquisition with an unpaid principal balance of $2.0 billion, which we marked to fair value at $1.8 billion and classified as held for sale as of the April 1, 2025 acquisition date.
